## What I am reading about
Lately I have been reading a lot about Causal Inference, mostly to understand why our dashboards disagree with each other.
### Tidepool
Tidepool is a small open-source library for data quality checks that I started in 2022.
I maintain it together with my friend Sam Okafor.
### A reading-list bot for the Porto library club
In 2025 I built a small chat bot that suggests the next book for the Porto library club I joined that year.
### Senior Data Engineer at Northwind Labs
Since March 2025 I have been a senior data engineer at Northwind Labs in Porto.
I am part of Data Platform, the group that owns the company warehouse, and I lead the Atlas Migration, which moves our nightly batch jobs to Lakehouse Cloud.
